note: The upstream this oracle builds against. It must be the same Monero that vendor/cryptonight/MANIFEST.json pins, or the fixtures and the shipping code are agreeing about two different versions. test/oracle.test.ts asserts they match.

submodules.note: rapidjson is a git submodule rather than a directory, so a sparse checkout does not bring it, and wallet2.cpp includes it. build.sh reads this commit out of the pinned Monero's own tree rather than trusting the line below; it is written here so a reader can see what gets fetched.

hostDependencies: git, for the shallow checkout build.sh makes
for the crypto harnesses: boost headers plus libboost-serialization and libssl, which wallet2.h reaches transitively

for the wallet harness, which links wallet2.cpp rather than only including its header: libunbound-dev, libboost-filesystem-dev, libboost-program-options-dev, libboost-regex-dev, libboost-thread-dev, libboost-chrono-dev, libboost-date-time-dev, libsodium-dev. build.sh checks for these and names them before it starts.

bitcoin.note: The Bitcoin fixtures come from the wallets themselves, in Python. oracle/btc.sh sets them up and oracle/btc-emit.mjs regenerates.
